rules.statement: In a partition case, it is incumbent on the judge to investigate into the title of each party before he arrives at a determination.
rules.supporting_quote: In a partition case, it is incumbent on the judge to investigate into the title of each party before he arrives at a determination [Chandrasena v. Piyasena and Others (1999) 3 SrLL.R. 201] and it would be the prime duty of the trial judge to carefully examine and investigate the actual rights and titles to the land sought to be partitioned [Sopinona v. Pitipanaarachchi and Two Others (2010) 1 SrLL.R. 87].
